WITH ins AS (
 INSERT INTO processed_messages(platform,external_account_id,message_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3)
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS is_new,
 $1::text AS platform,$2::text AS external_account_id,$3::text AS message_id,$4::text AS customer_external_id,
 $5::text AS message_type,$6::text AS message,$7::text AS media_id,$8::text AS media_url,$9::bigint AS event_timestamp,
 $10::text AS normalized_question,$11::text AS event_kind,$12::boolean AS is_echo;

WITH acct AS (
 SELECT ba.*,b.business_name,b.delivery_charge_default,b.payment_methods,b.ai_instructions,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(ba.ai_prompt_override,''),b.ai_instructions) AS effective_ai_instructions
 FROM business_accounts ba JOIN businesses b ON b.business_id=ba.business_id AND b.active=TRUE
 WHERE ba.platform=$1 AND ba.external_account_id=$3 AND ba.active=TRUE LIMIT 1
), cust AS (
 INSERT INTO customers(business_id,account_id,platform,external_user_id,updated_at)
 SELECT business_id,id,$1,$2,NOW() FROM acct
 ON CONFLICT(account_id,external_user_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=NOW() RETURNING *
), conv AS (
 INSERT INTO conversations(customer_id,state,context_json,last_customer_at,followup_enabled)
 SELECT id,'BROWSING','{}'::jsonb,NOW(),COALESCE((SELECT followup_enabled_default FROM acct),TRUE) FROM cust
 ON CONFLICT(customer_id) DO UPDATE SET last_customer_at=NOW(),next_followup_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW() RETURNING *
)
SELECT $1::text AS platform,acct.business_id,acct.id::text AS account_id,acct.external_account_id,
 $2::text AS sender_id,$4::text AS message_id,$5::text AS message_type,$6::text AS message,$7::text AS media_id,$8::text AS media_url,$9::text AS normalized_question,
 cust.id::text AS customer_id,conv.id::text AS conversation_id,conv.state AS conversation_state,conv.context_json,conv.human_mode,conv.mode_source,conv.handoff_reason,
 acct.business_name,acct.access_token,acct.reply_url,acct.operations_spreadsheet_id AS sheet_document_id,
 acct.order_sheet_name,acct.human_support_sheet_name,acct.product_sheet_name,acct.faq_sheet_name,
 acct.delivery_charge_default,acct.payment_methods,acct.effective_ai_instructions AS ai_instructions,
 acct.ai_provider,acct.ai_model,acct.conversation_url_template,acct.auto_human_on_manual_reply,
 acct.max_messages_per_minute,acct.max_ai_turns_per_hour,acct.max_ai_turns_per_day,acct.estimated_tokens_per_turn,acct.max_estimated_tokens_per_day,
 acct.followup_enabled_default,acct.followup_1_minutes,acct.followup_2_minutes
FROM acct JOIN cust ON TRUE JOIN conv ON TRUE;

parameters.query:
WITH prev AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(($4::jsonb #>> '{selected_product,productId}'),'')::bigint AS product_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE
      WHEN p.id = (SELECT product_id FROM prev) AND length($2) < 60 THEN 3.0
      ELSE GREATEST(similarity(p.search_text,$2), similarity(lower(p.name),$2))
    END AS score
  FROM products p
  WHERE p.account_id=$1::bigint AND p.active=TRUE
  ORDER BY score DESC, p.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
top_product AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1
),
cached AS (
  SELECT rc.*
  FROM response_cache rc, top_product tp
  WHERE rc.account_id=$1::bigint
    AND rc.intent='PRODUCT_SEARCH'
    AND rc.product_id=tp.id
    AND rc.product_version=tp.content_hash
    AND (rc.expires_at IS NULL OR rc.expires_at > NOW())
    AND similarity(rc.normalized_question,$2) >= 0.92
  ORDER BY similarity(rc.normalized_question,$2) DESC, rc.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  $3::jsonb AS base,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ranked) ORDER BY score DESC) FROM ranked),'[]'::jsonb) AS products,
  (SELECT id FROM top_product) AS top_product_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT content_hash FROM top_product),'') AS product_version,
  COALESCE((SELECT reply FROM cached),'') AS cache_reply,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM cached),0) AS cache_id;

parameters.query: UPDATE response_cache SET hit_count=hit_count+1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1;

SELECT
  $1::jsonb AS base,
  COALESCE(c.context_json->'order_draft','{}'::jsonb) AS draft,
  c.context_json->'selected_product' AS selected_product,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p))
    FROM (
      SELECT id,name,price,stock_qty,stock_status,color,size,description,image_url,content_hash
      FROM products
      WHERE account_id=$2::bigint AND active=TRUE
      ORDER BY updated_at DESC
      LIMIT 8
    ) p
  ),'[]'::jsonb) AS product_hint
FROM conversations c
WHERE c.id=$3::bigint;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE id=$1::bigint FOR UPDATE
),
merged AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.context_json->'order_draft','{}'::jsonb) || $2::jsonb AS d,
         c.context_json,
         c.id
  FROM c
),
selected AS (
  SELECT NULLIF((SELECT context_json #>> '{selected_product,productId}' FROM c),'')::bigint AS product_id
),
candidate AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM products p
  WHERE p.account_id=$3::bigint
    AND p.active=TRUE
    AND (
      p.id=(SELECT product_id FROM selected)
      OR ($4 <> '' AND similarity(p.search_text,lower($4)) >= 0.25)
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p.id=(SELECT product_id FROM selected) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
    similarity(p.search_text,lower($4)) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
final_draft AS (
  SELECT
    m.d ||
    CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM candidate)
      THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'product_id',(SELECT id FROM candidate),
        'product_name',(SELECT name FROM candidate)
      )
      ELSE '{}'::jsonb
    END AS d
  FROM merged m
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE conversations
  SET context_json=jsonb_set(context_json,'{order_draft}',(SELECT d FROM final_draft),true),
      state='ORDER_COLLECTING',
      updated_at=NOW()
  WHERE id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  $5::jsonb AS base,
  upd.context_json->'order_draft' AS draft,
  candidate.id AS verified_product_id,
  candidate.name AS verified_product_name,
  candidate.price AS verified_price,
  candidate.stock_qty AS verified_stock_qty,
  candidate.stock_status AS verified_stock_status
FROM upd
LEFT JOIN candidate ON TRUE;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE id=$1::bigint FOR UPDATE
),
cancel_order AS (
  UPDATE orders
  SET status='CANCELLED',updated_at=NOW()
  WHERE id=(
    SELECT id FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id=(SELECT customer_id FROM c)
      AND account_id=$2::bigint
      AND status IN ('PENDING','CONFIRMED','PROCESSING')
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  )
  RETURNING order_number
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE conversations
  SET state='BROWSING',
      context_json=context_json-'order_draft',
      followup_enabled=FALSE,
      next_followup_at=NULL,
      updated_at=NOW()
  WHERE id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT $3::jsonb AS base,
       COALESCE((SELECT order_number FROM cancel_order),'') AS cancelled_order;

SELECT $3::jsonb AS base,o.order_number,o.status,o.total,o.created_at,o.confirmed_at FROM customers c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id=c.id AND account_id=$2::bigint ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) o ON TRUE WHERE c.id=$1::bigint;

WITH cache AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM response_cache
  WHERE account_id=$1::bigint
    AND intent='GENERAL'
    AND product_id IS NULL
    AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>NOW())
    AND similarity(normalized_question,$2)>=0.94
  ORDER BY similarity(normalized_question,$2) DESC, updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
faqs AS (
  SELECT question,answer,category,similarity(search_text,$2) AS score
  FROM knowledge_base
  WHERE account_id=$1::bigint AND active=TRUE
  ORDER BY score DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  $3::jsonb AS base,
  COALESCE((SELECT reply FROM cache),'') AS cache_reply,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM cache),0) AS cache_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(faqs) ORDER BY score DESC) FROM faqs),'[]'::jsonb) AS faqs;

SELECT $1::text AS mode,$2::text AS challenge,$3::text AS verify_token,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM business_accounts WHERE active=TRUE AND COALESCE(verify_token,'')<>'' AND verify_token=$3) AS token_valid;

WITH m AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '1 minute')::int AS msg_min
 FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=$1::bigint AND direction='inbound'
), u AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '1 hour')::int AS turns_hour,
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE created_at>=CURRENT_DATE)::int AS turns_day,
        COALESCE(SUM(estimated_tokens) FILTER(WHERE created_at>=CURRENT_DATE),0)::int AS tokens_day
 FROM ai_turn_usage WHERE account_id=$2::bigint AND customer_id=$3::bigint
), decision AS (
 SELECT (m.msg_min <= $4::int AND u.turns_hour < $5::int AND u.turns_day < $6::int AND (u.tokens_day+$7::int) <= $8::int) AS allowed,
 CASE WHEN m.msg_min>$4::int THEN 'MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT' WHEN u.turns_hour >= $5::int THEN 'AI_HOURLY_LIMIT' WHEN u.turns_day >= $6::int THEN 'AI_DAILY_LIMIT' WHEN (u.tokens_day+$7::int)>$8::int THEN 'ESTIMATED_TOKEN_DAILY_LIMIT' ELSE 'OK' END AS reason
 FROM m,u
), reserve AS (
 INSERT INTO ai_turn_usage(business_id,account_id,customer_id,conversation_id,estimated_tokens)
 SELECT $9,$2::bigint,$3::bigint,$1::bigint,$7::int FROM decision WHERE allowed RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $10::jsonb AS base,(SELECT allowed FROM decision) AS allowed,(SELECT reason FROM decision) AS reason,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reserve) AS reserved;

), cust AS (

 ON CONFLICT(account_id,external_user_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=NOW() RETURNING *
), conv AS (
 INSERT INTO conversations(customer_id,state,context_json) SELECT id,'BROWSING','{}'::jsonb FROM cust

)
SELECT $1::text AS platform,acct.business_id,acct.id::text AS account_id,acct.external_account_id,$2::text AS customer_external_id,$4::text AS message_id,$5::text AS message,
 cust.id::text AS customer_id,conv.id::text AS conversation_id,conv.human_mode,acct.business_name,
